name: Ab Wheel Rollout
description: A kneeling core exercise in which an ab wheel is rolled forward and pulled back with the abs.
instructions: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders; brace your abs and set your back in a neutral position.
Roll the wheel forward without arching your lower back; stay within the distance where you can keep your torso steady.
Pull the wheel back toward your knees with your abs; shorten the range or stop if you feel discomfort in your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the ab wheel rollout, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ab Wheel ile Roll-out yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Adductor Ball Squeeze
description: A lying exercise in which a soft ball is squeezed between the knees to work the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees; place a soft pilates ball between your knees.
Exhale and squeeze the ball with your knees in a controlled way; keep your lower back and shoulders relaxed.
Release the squeeze and return to the start; apply light pressure without causing pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the adductor ball squeeze, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Adduktör Top Sıkıştırma yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Archer Push-Up
description: A wide-handed push-up in which the body shifts toward one arm while the opposite arm extends to the side.
instructions: Place your hands wider than your shoulders and take a plank position; keep the body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend one elbow and lower your chest toward that hand while extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Push back to the center under control; work both sides equally and put your knees down if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Archer Push-Up, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Okçu Şınavı hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Arnold Press
description: A seated dumbbell press that rotates the palms from facing the body to facing forward as the weights go overhead.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support; hold the dumbbells at shoulder height with your palms facing your torso.
As you press the dumbbells up, rotate your palms to face forward; keep your back against the bench and your torso still.
Perform the rotation under control and lower the dumbbells to shoulder height; shorten the range if your shoulder hurts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Arnold Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Arnold Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Assisted Pull-Up
description: A vertical pull-up performed on an assist machine that offsets part of the body weight.
instructions: Adjust the support of the assisted pull-up machine and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull your elbows down and lift your body up in a controlled manner.
Extend your arms slowly; do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Assisted Pull-Up, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yardımlı Barfiks hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: 45-Degree Back Extension
description: A hip-hinge back extension performed on a 45-degree bench that trains the lower back, glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Set the hip pad so it sits just below the pelvis; secure your feet.
Bend the torso forward from the hips, keeping the back neutral and the movement controlled.
Rise until the torso is in line with the legs; do not arch the lower back beyond that point.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the 45-Degree Back Extension, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: 45 Derece Sırt Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band Pull-Apart
description: A light band exercise in which the arms are opened to the sides to bring the shoulder blades together.
instructions: Hold a light band at chest height with your arms in front and your elbows soft.
Open your arms to the sides while bringing your shoulder blades toward each other; do not raise your shoulders.
Slowly bring the band back to the start while keeping tension; keep your torso still.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Band Pull-Apart, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bant Pull-Apart hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band-Resisted Lateral Neck Flexion
description: A very light band-resisted sideways neck bend performed through a small, comfortable range of motion.
instructions: Sit upright; place a very light band beside your head and tie it to a fixed point at head height.
Tilt your head sideways only through a small, comfortable range to gently resist the band; keep your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly return to the neutral position; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the band-resisted lateral neck flexion, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Yan Boyun Fleksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band-Resisted Neck Extension
description: A very light band-resisted backward neck extension performed through a small range of motion.
instructions: Sit upright; place a very light band behind your head and anchor it in front of you at head height.
Bring your head back from neutral by only a few degrees to gently resist the band; do not lean back excessively.
Return to the neutral position in a controlled way; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the band-resisted neck extension, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Boyun Ekstansiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Band-Resisted Neck Flexion
description: A very light band-resisted forward neck flexion performed through a small range of motion.
instructions: Sit upright; place a very light band on your forehead and anchor it behind you at head height.
Tilt your neck forward only a few degrees to gently resist the band; keep your shoulders relaxed.
Return to the neutral position in a controlled way; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the band-resisted neck flexion, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Boyun Fleksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Banded Clamshell
description: A side-lying hip exercise in which the top knee opens against a light band to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side, bend your knees and place a light band above your knees; keep your feet stacked.
Open your top knee in a controlled way without rolling your torso and hips backward.
Slowly close the knee against the resistance of the band; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the banded clamshell, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Clamshell yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Banded Monster Walk
description: A band-resisted walk in a small squat with sideways steps that works the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Place a mini band above your knees; bend your knees slightly and squat a little from the hips.
Keeping the band tense, take a controlled step to the side; track your knees in the direction of your feet.
Do not let the band go slack as you bring the other foot closer; travel equally in both directions.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the banded monster walk, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Canavar Yürüyüşü yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Back Squat
description: A loaded squat with the bar supported across the upper back.
instructions: Place the bar across the upper back and set your feet at a comfortable, balanced width.
Brace the abs and send the hips down and back; keep the knees tracking over the toes.
Descend to a depth you can control and drive up through the feet to stand.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Back Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Sırt Squatı hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: A horizontal barbell press performed while lying on a bench.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, plant your feet firmly and hold the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Set the shoulder blades into the bench and lower the bar under control to the mid-lower chest.
Keep the wrists stacked over the elbows and press the bar up; use a spotter on heavy attempts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete pressing a barbell above a flat bench, with the chest highlighted red and an upward arrow.
alt.tr: Düz sehpada halteri yukarı iten gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla ve itiş yönü okla gösteriliyor.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Bench Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Bench Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Curl
description: An elbow flexion exercise that curls a barbell with an underhand grip to train the biceps.
instructions: Hold the bar with your palms facing forward; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Raise the bar toward your shoulders without moving your elbows forward.
Lower the bar under control and keep your wrists straight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Pazı Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
description: A hip extension movement performed with the upper back on a bench and a loaded barbell across the hips.
instructions: Rest the upper back on a bench and place the bar in the crease of the hips; use a pad for comfort.
Plant the feet on the floor and lift the hips upward while keeping the ribs down.
Squeeze the glutes when the torso is parallel to the floor; lower under control without over-arching the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Hip Thrust, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Hip Thrust hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: A standing shrug that raises the shoulders toward the ears while holding a barbell in front of the thighs.
instructions: Hold the bar in front of your thighs with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears; do not roll them in circles.
Pause briefly at the top and slowly lower your shoulders back to the start.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Barbell Shrug Behind The Back
description: A standing shrug with the barbell held behind the body, raising the shoulders straight up.
instructions: Hold a light bar behind you with your arms straight and your palms facing backward.
Raise your shoulders straight up; do not bend your elbows or roll your shoulders in circles.
Pause briefly and slowly lower your shoulders; make sure the bar does not hit your legs.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Shrug Behind The Back, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Arkadan Halterle Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bayesian Cable Curl
description: A single-arm cable curl performed with the cable behind the body to keep tension on the biceps in the stretched position.
instructions: Attach a single handle to a low pulley; step slightly forward so the cable stays behind you.
Keeping your elbow fixed slightly behind your torso, curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Extend your arm slowly; if you feel tension or pain in the shoulder, change the starting position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bayesian Cable Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bayesian Kablo Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl
description: A wrist flexion exercise performed with a light barbell held behind the body to train the forearm flexors.
instructions: Hold a light bar behind you with your arms extended comfortably and your palms facing backward.
Keeping your shoulders still, raise the bar by curling your wrists in a controlled way.
Lower your wrists slowly back to the start; stop if you feel pain or numbness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Behind-the-Back Barbell Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sırt Arkasında Halterle Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bench Dip
description: A bodyweight elbow extension movement with the hands supported behind the body.
instructions: Place hands behind the hips on a stable bench.
Bend the elbows to lower, then press back up.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
description: A barbell row performed while holding a stable hip hinge.
instructions: Grip the bar and hinge at the hips; keep the back neutral and hold the torso angle.
Drive the elbows back and row the bar toward the lower ribs.
Lower the bar under control; reduce the load if the lower back starts to round.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Barbell Bent-Over Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Eğilerek Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: A floor abdominal exercise in which opposite elbow and knee are brought together in an alternating pedaling motion.
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and lightly place your hands beside your head.
Rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee in a controlled way while extending the other leg; keep your lower back comfortably on the floor.
Alternate sides as if pedaling; work slowly and in control without pulling your neck with your hands.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the bicycle crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bisiklet Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bird Dog
description: A quadruped exercise in which the opposite arm and leg are extended while the spine stays neutral.
instructions: Place your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips; keep your back neutral.
Extend the opposite arm and leg without rotating the torso and hold your balance briefly.
Return to the start under control and switch sides; do not let your lower back sag.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bird Dog, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bird Dog hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bodyweight Squat
description: A squat performed without external load, using the hips and knees to lower and rise.
instructions: Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Bend the knees and hips, then stand back up.

name: Bodyweight Triceps Extension
description: A bodyweight elbow extension performed by leaning back from a fixed bar and lowering the forehead toward it to train the triceps.
instructions: Grip a sturdy, non-slip bar at shoulder width; keep your torso straight and lean backward.
Keeping your elbows forward and fixed, bend your arms enough to bring your forehead close to the bar.
Use your triceps to extend your elbows and return to the start; adjust your foot position to change the difficulty.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bodyweight Triceps Extension, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Vücut Ağırlığıyla Arka Kol Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot raised on a low, stable bench.
instructions: Place the rear foot on a low, stable bench and set the front foot at a balanced distance.
Keep the torso balanced, bend both knees and lower to a depth you can control.
Drive up through the front foot; work both sides and take support if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Bulgarian Split Squat, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bulgar Split Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Crossover
description: A standing cable movement in which the arms sweep forward and down to bring the hands together in front of the body.
instructions: Attach handles to two high pulleys and stand balanced in the middle; lean your torso slightly forward.
Keeping your elbows soft, bring your arms together forward and downward.
Open your arms to the sides under control; stay in a comfortable stretch range without swinging the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Crossover, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Crossover hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Crunch
description: A kneeling abdominal exercise in which the torso curls forward against the resistance of a high cable.
instructions: Attach the rope to the high pulley and kneel down; hold the rope at the sides of your head.
Keeping your hips as still as possible, brace your abs and curl your torso forward in a controlled way.
Return to the start without swinging the cable; do not pull your neck with your hands.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
description: A cable hip extension in which the leg is driven backward against a low pulley with an ankle cuff.
instructions: Attach the ankle cuff to the low pulley and take support from a stable point.
Keep the knee slightly bent and extend the leg backward from the hip; hold the torso and lower back still.
Slowly bring the leg back to the start; work both sides without arching the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Glute Kickback, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Glute Kickback hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Hip Abduction
description: A standing hip exercise in which the working leg is pulled out to the side against a low cable.
instructions: Attach the ankle cuff to the low cable and stand balanced next to the machine.
Keeping your torso still, open the working leg out to the side in a controlled way.
Return the leg to the starting position without swinging it; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo ile Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
description: A standing hip exercise in which the working leg is pulled inward across the body against a low cable.
instructions: Attach the ankle strap to the low pulley; stand sideways to the machine and hold on for support.
Pull the working leg inward in front of your body in a controlled way; do not rotate your hips.
Return to the start against the resistance; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable hip adduction, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo ile Kalça Addüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: A cable hip hinge in which the rope is pulled through the legs from a low pulley.
instructions: Attach a rope to the low pulley, face away from the cable and hold the rope between the legs.
Bend the knees slightly and send the hips back while keeping the back neutral.
Stand tall by bringing the hips forward; repeat with control without pushing the lower back backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Pull-Through, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Pull-Through hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
description: A cable fly in which the arms open out to the sides to train the rear deltoids.
instructions: Attach handles to two low pulleys and stand in front of the cables; grip the handles with crossed hands.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent, open your arms out to the sides; keep your torso still.
Bring your arms back to the crossed start position under control; do not swing the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Rear Delt Fly, rear deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Arka Omuz Fly hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Woodchop
description: A standing rotational exercise in which a cable is pulled diagonally downward across the body with the torso.
instructions: Set the cable above head height and grip the handle with both hands; set your feet balanced.
Keeping your arms slightly bent, rotate your torso diagonally downward in a controlled way; keep your hips still.
Return to the start slowly; do not swing the movement from your lower back and work both sides equally.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cable woodchop, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Woodchop yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
description: A wrist curl with the palms facing up and a short bar on a low cable pulley to train the forearm flexors.
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley; support your forearms on your thighs and turn your palms up.
Without moving your forearms, raise the bar slightly by bending your wrists.
Lower the bar under control; stop the movement if you feel wrist pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Wrist Extension
description: A wrist extension with the palms facing down and a short bar on a low cable pulley to train the forearm extensors.
instructions: Attach a short bar to a low pulley; support your forearms on your thighs and turn your palms down.
With your forearms still, extend your wrists backward.
Lower the bar slowly; work within a small, pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Wrist Extension, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Bilek Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cable Y Raise
description: A light cable raise in which the arms are lifted up and out in a Y shape to train the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the two low cables crossed; start with your arms slightly bent in front of your torso.
Raise your arms up and out under control to form a Y shape; keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Lower the weights slowly to the start; use a light load and do not lean back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Y Raise, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Y Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Standing Calf Raise
description: An ankle extension movement performed by rising onto the balls of the feet.
instructions: Place the balls of the feet on a low, stable step and hold a support for balance.
Lower the heels through a comfortable range of motion.
Rise up onto the toes, pause briefly at the top and lower slowly.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Standing Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayakta Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
description: A dumbbell row performed lying face down on an incline bench so the chest supports the torso.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench and hold the dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Keeping your chest on the bench, pull your elbows back and bring the dumbbells toward your ribs.
Extend your arms under control without letting your shoulders drop forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Göğüs Destekli Dambıl Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Shrug
description: A shrug performed face down on an incline bench so the chest supports the torso.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench and hold light dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Without bending your elbows, raise your shoulders toward your ears under control.
Pause briefly and slowly lower your shoulders; do not strain your neck and do not swing the dumbbells.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Chest-Supported Dumbbell Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Göğüs Destekli Dambıl Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Chin Tuck
description: A small seated head-retraction movement that gently works the deep neck flexors.
instructions: Sit upright and look straight ahead; relax your shoulders and keep your head neutral.
Without tilting your chin down, slide your head straight back in a line; make a small double-chin movement.
Hold briefly and release; repeat without forcing the movement and stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the chin tuck, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çene İçe Alma (Chin Tuck) yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Chin-Up
description: A vertical bodyweight pull using an underhand grip on a secure bar.
instructions: Hang from a sturdy bar with palms facing you at shoulder width and shoulders away from the ears.
Pull the elbows down to bring the chin toward bar level; do not swing the legs.
Lower under control by extending the arms; shorten the rep if you feel shoulder pain or lose control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Chin-Up, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Tutuş Barfiks hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
description: A cable pulldown with a close neutral-grip V handle that brings the handle to the upper chest.
instructions: Attach a close-grip V bar to the high pulley; secure the thigh pad and grip the handle.
Keeping your torso upright, pull your elbows down and close to your body; bring the bar to your upper chest.
Extend your arms under control; do not pull the bar behind your neck and do not swing your torso.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dar Tutuşla Önden Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
description: A push-up with the hands placed at shoulder width or closer and the elbows kept near the torso to emphasize the triceps.
instructions: Get into a plank position with your hands at shoulder width or slightly narrower; keep your body straight.
Keeping your elbows close to your torso, lower your chest toward the floor under control.
Push the floor away to return to the start; if needed, put your knees on the floor and keep your wrists in a pain-free position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Close-Grip Push-Up, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dar Tutuşlu Şınav hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Concentration Curl
description: A seated single-arm dumbbell curl with the elbow braced against the inner thigh to isolate the biceps.
instructions: Sit with your legs comfortably apart; rest the elbow of your working arm on the inside of the thigh on the same side.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm and torso still.
Lower the weight under control and switch sides; keep your wrist straight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Concentration Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Konsantrasyon Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Conventional Deadlift
description: A barbell lift from the floor that combines leg drive and hip extension.
instructions: Bring the bar over midfoot, hinge at the hips to grip it and keep a neutral spine.
Brace the abs and lift the bar close to the legs, extending hips and knees together.
Lower the bar along the same line under control; if the back rounds, reduce the load or get coaching.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Conventional Deadlift, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Klasik Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cossack Squat
description: A wide-stance lateral squat in which the body shifts onto one bent leg while the other leg stays straight.
instructions: Set your feet wide apart; if needed, lightly hold a stable support for balance.
Send your hips to one side and bend that knee; keep the other leg comfortably straight.
Push through your foot to return to the center and move to the other side; stay in a pain-free, controllable depth.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the cossack squat, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kosak Squat yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension
description: A single-arm high-cable triceps extension in which the forearm is extended down and across the body.
instructions: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grip it with your working hand; keep your elbow at your side.
Extend your forearm under control across your body and downward.
Return to the start with your elbow fixed; do not rotate your shoulder, and stop if you feel pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cross-Body Cable Triceps Extension, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çapraz Kablo Arka Kol Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
description: A hammer curl in which the dumbbell is raised across the torso toward the opposite shoulder to train the biceps and brachialis.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Raise one dumbbell across the front of your torso toward the opposite shoulder; do not rotate your wrist.
Lower the weight under control and repeat with the other arm; do not round your shoulder forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cross-Body Hammer Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çapraz Çekiç Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cuban Press
description: A light dumbbell exercise that rotates the forearms upward from an elbow-bent position at shoulder height to train the rotator cuff and deltoids.
instructions: Hold very light dumbbells and bend your elbows at shoulder height; spread your upper arms out to the sides.
Keeping the elbow angle, slowly rotate your forearms upward; progress only within a comfortable range.
Return to the start under control; use a very light load in this movement and stop if your shoulder is uncomfortable.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cuban Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Cuban Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Cyclist Squat
description: A narrow-stance squat with the heels raised on a low surface to bias the front of the thighs.
instructions: Place the heels on a low, stable raised surface and set the feet in a narrow, balanced stance.
Keeping the torso upright, squat to a comfortable depth while the knees track in line with the toes.
Push through the soles of the feet to stand up under control; reduce the depth if you feel knee pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cyclist Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bisikletçi Squatı hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Decline Dumbbell Press
description: A dumbbell press performed on a declined bench that emphasizes the lower chest.
instructions: Secure your feet safely on the declined bench and hold the dumbbells at the lower sides of your chest.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest under control; keep your wrists above your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest; get help to put them down if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Decline Dumbbell Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Alt Eğimli Dambıl Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Decline Push-Up
description: A push-up with the feet elevated on a bench, shifting more load toward the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Place your feet on a sturdy bench and your hands on the floor at shoulder width; keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows under control and bring your chest toward the floor.
Push the floor away and return to the start; if your lower back sags, choose a lower elevation.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Decline Push-Up, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayakları Yükseltilmiş Şınav hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Decline Sit-Up
description: A sit-up performed on a decline bench with the feet anchored to increase the range and load on the abs.
instructions: Secure your feet safely to the decline bench; cross your arms over your chest.
Brace your abs and raise your torso toward your knees; do not pull your neck with your hands.
Lower your torso to the bench in a controlled way; do not work at a depth that strains your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the decline sit-up, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Mekik yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Deficit Push-Up
description: A push-up performed on handles so the chest can lower slightly below hand level.
instructions: Place sturdy push-up handles at shoulder width and take a plank position.
Bend your elbows under control and lower your chest slightly below the level of your hands; keep your body straight.
Push up from a depth that is pain-free and that you can control; if you feel discomfort in your shoulders, shorten the range of motion.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Deficit Push-Up, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tutaçlı Derin Şınav hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Donkey Calf Raises
description: A calf raise performed bent forward at the hips with the toes on a raised surface and the hands on a support.
instructions: Place the toes on a stable raised surface and support yourself with the hands on a sturdy bench; hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the heels within a comfortable range, then rise up onto the toes.
Pause briefly at the top and lower slowly; do not bounce or let go of the balance support.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Donkey Calf Raises, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eşek Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Donkey Kick
description: A bodyweight hip extension performed on hands and knees by lifting one bent leg toward the ceiling.
instructions: Get on your hands and knees; stabilise the torso and keep the neck neutral.
Keeping one knee bent, lift the foot toward the ceiling without arching the lower back.
Bring the knee back toward the floor under control and switch sides; keep the hip movement small and balanced.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Donkey Kick, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eşek Tekmesi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
description: A horizontal press using a dumbbell in each hand while lying on a bench.
instructions: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower the weights beside the chest and press upward.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
description: An elbow flexion movement with a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the sides with elbows near the torso.
Bend the elbows to raise the weights and lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Fly
description: A chest isolation movement in which dumbbells are opened in a wide arc while lying on a flat bench.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold light dumbbells over your chest; bend your elbows slightly.
Open your arms to the sides in a wide arc, down to a depth where your shoulders feel comfortable.
Use your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back up; if you feel strain in your shoulders, shorten the range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Fly, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Fly hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Forearm Pronation-Supination
description: A light forearm rotation exercise in which a dumbbell held by one end is turned palm up and palm down.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench; hold a very light dumbbell by one end.
Keeping your elbow fixed, slowly turn your palm up, then down.
Return to the start under control; reduce the range or stop if your wrist hurts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Forearm Pronation-Supination, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Ön Kol Pronasyon-Supinasyon hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
description: A standing dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out to the sides to train the side deltoids.
instructions: Hold light dumbbells at your sides; keep your elbows soft and your torso still.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height; do not pull your shoulders toward your ears.
Lower the dumbbells under control; choose a load you can lift without swinging.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Lateral Raise, side deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Yana Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; yan omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
description: A bench movement in which one dumbbell is moved in an arc from above the chest to behind the head.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold one light dumbbell over your chest with both hands; keep your elbows soft.
Move your arms in a controlled arc behind your head; stop where your shoulders feel comfortable.
Bring the dumbbell back over your chest; do not over-arch your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Pullover, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Pullover hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Radial Deviation
description: A light wrist exercise in which an upright dumbbell is raised toward the thumb side of the wrist.
instructions: Rest your forearm on a bench with your wrist hanging off the edge; hold a light dumbbell upright.
Without moving your forearm, raise your wrist in the direction of your thumb through a small range.
Lower the dumbbell slowly to the start; work with a light load and stop if you feel wrist pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Radial Deviation, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Radyal Deviasyon hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
description: A wrist extension exercise with the palm facing down, using a dumbbell to train the forearm extensors.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh; hold the dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Keeping your forearm still, raise the back of your hand upward in a controlled way.
Lower your wrist slowly; use a small, comfortable range of motion.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Ters Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
description: A hip hinge performed with a dumbbell in each hand held close to the legs.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells in front of the thighs; set the feet hip-width apart with the knees slightly bent.
Keeping the back neutral, send the hips back and lower the dumbbells close to the legs.
When you feel a stretch in the hamstrings, bring the hips forward and stand up; do not round the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Romanya Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: An overhead press using two independently held dumbbells.
instructions: Hold dumbbells beside the shoulders with palms forward.
Press upward without leaning back, then lower.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: A standing shrug performed with a dumbbell in each hand at the sides.
instructions: Stand tall holding the dumbbells at your sides and let your arms hang relaxed.
Raise your shoulders straight up toward your ears without rolling them forward or back.
Slowly lower your shoulders back to the start; do not strain your neck.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Skull Crusher
description: A lying triceps extension in which light dumbbells are lowered toward the sides of the head by bending the elbows.
instructions: Lie on a bench and hold light dumbbells above your chest; straighten your arms.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells toward the sides of your head.
Extend your elbows under control to return to the start; do not bring the weight close to your head and stay in a comfortable range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Skull Crusher, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Skull Crusher hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
description: A dumbbell press in which the dumbbells are pressed together throughout the lift to keep the chest under tension.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold light dumbbells over your chest so that they touch each other.
Keep pressing the dumbbells together as you lower them to your chest under control.
Press up from chest level; set your shoulders on the bench and do not attempt this with heavy loads.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Squeeze Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıl Sıkıştırma Presi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
description: A step-up onto a stable box performed with a dumbbell held in each hand.
instructions: Stand in front of a sturdy box of a manageable height, holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Place one foot fully on the box and rise with that leg, keeping the knee in line with the toes.
Lower the other foot under control and switch sides; make sure the box is stable.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Step Ups, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambıllı Step-Up hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Dumbbell Triceps Kickback
description: A bent-over single-arm exercise in which the forearm is extended backward with the upper arm fixed to train the triceps.
instructions: Support one hand on a bench; hinge forward at the hips and hold the dumbbell in your other hand.
Fix your elbow at your side and extend your forearm backward.
Bend your elbow under control to return to the start; do not swing your upper arm and work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Triceps Kickback, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Arka Kol Kickback hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Dumbbell Z Press
description: A dumbbell overhead press performed seated on the floor with the legs extended, which removes leg drive and demands an upright torso.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended in front; find a position where you can keep your torso upright and bring the dumbbells to shoulder height.
Without leaning back from your lower back, press the dumbbells overhead under control.
Lower the weights slowly to your shoulders; reduce the load if your torso drifts backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Dumbbell Z Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Z Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
description: A lying triceps extension in which an EZ bar is lowered toward the forehead by bending the elbows.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench and hold a light EZ bar above your chest; keep your wrists neutral.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows and lower the bar under control to near your forehead.
Extend your elbows to bring the bar back to the start; do not touch the bar to your face and use a spotter if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the EZ-Bar Skull Crusher, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: EZ Barla Skull Crusher hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Face Pull
description: A cable row to the face with a rope that trains the rear deltoids and the muscles around the shoulder blades.
instructions: Attach the rope to a pulley at face height and grip both ends with your thumbs pointing backward.
Pull the rope toward your face by flaring your elbows out; do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.
Extend your arms under control and keep your torso still.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Face Pull, rear deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Face Pull hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Farmer Carry
description: A loaded walk while holding a weight at each side.
instructions: Pick up weights you can control in each hand and stand tall with the shoulders relaxed back.
Walk with short, balanced steps without leaning to the side.
Put the weights down safely; do not shrug and make sure the path is clear.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Farmer Carry, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çift Taraflı Ağırlık Taşıma hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Floor Crunch
description: A basic floor abdominal exercise in which the shoulder blades are lifted off the ground by bracing the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back, bend your knees and plant your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor in a controlled way; do not pull your neck with your hands.
Pause briefly and slowly lower your torso back to the starting position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the floor crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yerde Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Frog Pump
description: A floor hip extension performed lying on the back with the soles of the feet together and the knees dropped out.
instructions: Lie on your back, press the soles of the feet together and let the knees fall comfortably to the sides.
Brace the abdomen slightly and lift the hips off the floor without over-arching the lower back.
Squeeze the glutes and hold briefly at the top, then lower to the floor under control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Frog Pump, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kurbağa Pump hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Front Squat
description: A barbell squat with the load across the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Rest the bar on the front of the shoulders with the elbows raised and feet at a comfortable width.
Brace the abs and squat; track the knees over the toes and keep the heels down.
From a controlled depth, drive through the feet to stand with the torso upright.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Front Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ön Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Full Copenhagen Plank
description: A side plank with the top ankle on a bench and the bottom leg lifted, loading the inner thigh muscles with a short isometric hold.
instructions: Get into a side plank position; place your top ankle on a sturdy bench and align your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips to form a straight line from head to ankle; raise your bottom leg off the floor.
Hold the position briefly and in control, then lower; work both sides and release if you feel pain in the groin.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the full copenhagen plank, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tam Kopenhag Plank yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Glute Bridge
description: A floor-based hip extension movement with the upper back and feet supported.
instructions: Lie on the back with knees bent and feet planted.
Lift the hips until the torso and thighs align, then lower.

name: Goblet Squat
description: A squat with a weight held in front of the chest, encouraging an upright torso.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell upright in front of the chest and set your feet at a comfortable width.
Send the hips down and back, keeping the torso upright and the knees tracking over the toes.
Stand by driving through the feet; stay within a depth you can control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Goblet Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Goblet Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Good Morning
description: A barbell hip hinge performed with the bar across the upper back and the torso tipping forward from the hips.
instructions: Place a light bar securely on the upper back; set the feet hip-width apart with the knees slightly bent.
Keep the spine neutral, send the hips back and tip the torso forward from the hips.
When you feel tension in the hamstrings, bring the hips forward and stand up; do not round the lower back and start light.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Good Morning, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Good Morning hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hack Squat
description: A machine squat performed with the back against a pad and the feet on an angled platform.
instructions: Set the shoulders under the pads and the back against the machine; place the feet on the platform at a comfortable width.
Lower the platform under control while the knees travel in line with the feet.
Keeping the heels on the platform, push back up and return to the start without locking the knees at the top.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hack Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hack Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Half-Kneeling Band Lat Pulldown
description: A one-arm band pulldown performed from a half-kneeling position with the band anchored overhead.
instructions: Anchor the band above head height; kneel on one knee and grip the band with one hand.
Pull your elbow toward your ribs; keep your torso upright and still.
Extend your arm back up under control; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Half-Kneeling Band Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yarım Diz Çökerek Bantla Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hammer Curl
description: A dumbbell curl performed with the palms facing each other that trains the biceps and the brachialis.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders without moving your upper arms.
Lower the dumbbells under control without swinging; keep your wrists neutral.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hammer Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Çekiç Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hamstring Walkout
description: A bodyweight bridge exercise in which the heels walk away from the hips while the hips stay lifted.
instructions: Lie on your back with the knees bent and the feet close to the hips; lift the hips into a bridge position.
Walk the heels forward in small steps, extending as far as you can while keeping the hips controlled and high.
Walk the heels back with steps and lower the hips; do not arch the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hamstring Walkout, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hamstring Walkout hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hand-Resisted Neck Isometric
description: A gentle isometric neck hold in which one hand provides very light resistance beside the temple.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place your palm beside your temple.
Apply very light resistance with your hand without turning your head, and gently tense your neck muscles.
Hold briefly and release; stop immediately if you feel sharp pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hand-resisted neck isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: El Dirençli Boyun İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: A hanging abdominal exercise in which the knees are drawn up toward the chest from a bar.
instructions: Hang from a sturdy bar; move your shoulders away from your ears and keep your torso stable.
Bend your knees, brace your abs and raise your knees toward your chest in a controlled way.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging; perform the movement in a pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hanging knee raise, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Asılı Diz Çekme yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Heel-Drop Calf Raise
description: A calf raise from the edge of a step that lets the heels sink below step level for a deeper stretch.
instructions: Press the toes onto the edge of a stable step; take support from a railing or wall for balance.
Lower the heels in a controlled way below step level within a comfortable range.
Rise onto the toes and return slowly to the start; do not bounce and do not go to a depth that causes pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Heel-Drop Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Topuk Düşürmeli Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hip Airplane
description: A single-leg balance drill that rotates the pelvis open and closed over a hinged hip.
instructions: Stand on one foot with the knee slightly bent; hinge forward at the hips and extend the free leg backward.
With the torso steady, rotate the pelvis open and closed under control; extend the arms to the sides or take support for balance.
Return upright; keep the movement small and pain-free, then switch sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Hip Airplane, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hip Airplane hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Hip Hike
description: A single-leg stance exercise on a step in which the pelvis is lowered and raised to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Stand on one foot at the edge of a low, stable step; hold a railing for balance.
As your free foot drops down beside the step, let your hip lower slightly, then raise your hip with your standing leg.
Keep your torso upright and repeat in a small, controlled range; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hip hike, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kalça Yükseltme (Hip Hike) yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Hollow Body Hold
description: A static core hold lying on the back in which the shoulders and feet are lifted while the lower back stays pressed down.
instructions: Lie on your back and gently press your lower back into the floor; start with your knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and feet slightly and hold the position by bracing your abs.
If your lower back starts to lift, bend your knees more; hold for a controlled time without holding your breath.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the hollow body hold, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Hollow Body Tutuşu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: A barbell press performed on an inclined bench that emphasizes the upper chest.
instructions: Set the bench to a slight incline, plant your feet on the floor and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Set your shoulder blades on the bench and lower the bar toward your upper chest under control.
Press the bar up while keeping your wrists above your elbows; use a spotter on heavy attempts.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Incline Barbell Bench Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Halter Bench Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: A dumbbell curl performed seated on an incline bench so the arms hang behind the torso, stretching the biceps.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench; let your arms hang down and keep your elbows at your sides.
Raise the dumbbells toward your shoulders without moving your elbows from their place.
Lower the weights slowly; do not round your shoulders forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Incline Dumbbell Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Dambıl Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Incline Push-Up
description: A push-up with the hands elevated on a stable surface to adjust the load.
instructions: Place hands on a stable raised surface and walk the feet back.
Lower the chest toward the surface, then press away.

name: Inverted Row
description: A bodyweight row performed hanging under a fixed bar with the body held straight.
instructions: Get under a sturdy, waist-height bar and grip it at shoulder width; keep your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the bar and bring your shoulder blades toward each other.
Extend your arms under control and return to the start; do not let your hips drop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Inverted Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Kelso Shrug
description: A shrug variation performed face down on an incline bench that pulls the shoulder blades together.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench and hold light dumbbells with your arms hanging down.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades toward each other.
Pause briefly and lower your shoulders forward under control; do not swing the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Kelso Shrug, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kelso Omuz Silkme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Kettlebell Deadlift
description: A hip hinge that lifts a kettlebell from between the feet.
instructions: Stand over a kettlebell and hinge to grip its handle.
Push through the feet to stand, then hinge back down.

name: Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift
description: A single-kettlebell deadlift with the weight beside one foot, which resists side bending of the trunk.
instructions: Place the kettlebell beside the outside of one foot; set your feet hip-width apart and hinge at the hips and knees.
Keeping your spine neutral and your shoulders level, lift the kettlebell off the floor.
Lower the weight to the floor along the same controlled path; do not lean sideways and start with a light load.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Kettlebell Suitcase Deadlift, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell Valiz Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Kettlebell Swing
description: A ballistic hip hinge in which a kettlebell is swung to chest height by a powerful hip drive.
instructions: Hold the kettlebell with both hands and set the feet shoulder-width apart; hinge back at the hips.
Drive the hips forward powerfully but under control and swing the kettlebell to chest height; keep the arms loose.
Let the weight swing back between the legs and hinge at the hips again; do not round the lower back and learn with a light load.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Kettlebell Swing, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kettlebell Swing hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Knee-Supported Copenhagen Plank
description: A side plank variation in which the top knee rests on a bench to load the inner thigh muscles with a short isometric hold.
instructions: Get into a side plank position and place your top knee on a sturdy, non-slip bench.
Lift your hips off the floor to form a straight line from head to knee; hold briefly.
Lower in a controlled way; start with short holds and release if you feel pain in the knee or groin.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the knee-supported copenhagen plank, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Diz Destekli Kopenhag Plank yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Landmine Row
description: A barbell row with one end of the bar anchored in a landmine sleeve.
instructions: Place one end of the bar in a fixed landmine sleeve and take a suitable handle.
Lean your torso forward and keep your back neutral; pull your elbows back and bring the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower the weight to the start without jerking; do not rotate your torso during the pull.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Landmine Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Landmine Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lat Pulldown
description: A vertical cable pull that brings the handle toward the upper chest.
instructions: Sit at a pulldown station and grip the bar.
Pull the bar toward the upper chest, then let it rise slowly.

alt.en: Wide-grip lat pulldown example: seated athlete holding the bar overhead, with lats highlighted red and assisting muscles lighter red.
alt.tr: Geniş tutuşlu lat pulldown örneği: oturan sporcu barı başının üzerinde tutuyor; lat kasları koyu, yardımcı kaslar açık kırmızıyla gösteriliyor.

alt.en: Wide-grip front lat pulldown example: seated athlete pulling the bar to the upper chest, with lats red and assisting arm muscles lighter red.
alt.tr: Geniş tutuşlu önden lat pulldown örneği: oturan sporcu barı üst göğsüne çekiyor; lat kasları koyu, yardımcı kol kasları açık kırmızıyla gösteriliyor.

name: Lateral Band Walk
description: A band-resisted sideways walk in a shallow squat that works the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Place a light band above your knees; set your feet hip-width apart and soften your knees.
Keeping the shallow squat position, take small, controlled steps to the side.
Keep the band tense as you bring your feet back together; travel equally in both directions.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the lateral band walk, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bantlı Yana Yürüyüş yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lateral Hand-Resisted Neck Isometric
description: A gentle isometric neck hold in which the hand resists sideways pressure of the head beside the temple.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place your palm beside your temple.
Apply very light resistance with your hand without moving your head; hold briefly and keep breathing.
Release and switch to the other side; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the lateral hand-resisted neck isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: El Dirençli Yan Boyun İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: A lunge to the side in which the hips shift back over one bent knee while the other leg stays straight.
instructions: Stand upright with your feet hip-width apart; leave room to step to the side.
Take a wide step to one side and bend that knee, sending your hips back; keep your other leg comfortably straight.
Push through the bent leg to return to the center; let your knee track in the same direction as your toes.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the lateral lunge, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Lunge yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Leg Extensions
description: A machine knee extension that isolates the front of the thigh.
instructions: Sit in the machine with the back against the support and adjust the pad above the ankles.
Extend the knees in a controlled way and straighten the legs in front of you; do not lock the knees hard.
Lower the weight slowly and keep the movement within a comfortable range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Leg Extensions, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bacak Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Leg Press Calf Raise
description: A calf raise performed on the leg press by pressing the platform with the balls of the feet.
instructions: Load the leg press lightly; place the toes on the lower part of the platform and let the heels hang free.
Without locking the knees, push through the toes to raise the heels.
Lower the heels under control; keep safe contact with the platform and work in a pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Leg Press Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Leg Press ile Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Lying Leg Curls
description: A machine knee flexion performed lying face down that isolates the back of the thigh.
instructions: Lie face down on the machine and set the pad just above the ankles.
Keeping the hips on the bench, bend the knees and bring the heels toward the buttocks under control.
Straighten the legs slowly without dropping the weight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Lying Leg Curls, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yatarak Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Chest Press
description: A seated machine press that pushes the handles forward from chest level.
instructions: Adjust the seat height so the handles are at chest level; plant your feet on the floor.
Push the handles forward; keep your shoulders down and do not lock your elbows.
Release the resistance under control and bring the handles back toward your chest.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Chest Press, chest highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Göğüs Presi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; göğüs kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Hip Abduction
description: A seated machine exercise in which the knees are pressed outward against pads to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Adjust the machine; place the outsides of your knees on the pads and keep your torso upright.
Open your knees outward in a controlled way; do not rock your torso or move your lower back.
Slowly release the resistance and bring your knees back to the start.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the machine hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Hip Thrust
description: A hip thrust performed on a dedicated machine with a pad across the hips.
instructions: Set the back against the support, bring the machine pad to the crease of the hips and plant the feet on the floor.
Keeping the ribs down, lift the hips until the shoulders, hips and knees are in line.
Squeeze the glutes with a brief pause and lower under control without over-arching the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Hip Thrust, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Hip Thrust hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Machine Pullover
description: A machine movement in which the upper arms drive pads downward in an arc to work the lats.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place your upper arms on the pads; keep your ribs down and your back supported.
With your elbows slightly bent, pull the arms down in a controlled arc.
Slowly release the resistance and raise your arms back to a comfortable shoulder range; do not overstretch.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Pullover, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Pullover hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Machine Shoulder Press
description: A seated overhead press on a guided machine that trains the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the seat and handles to your shoulder height; rest your back on the support and plant your feet on the floor.
Press the handles overhead; do not over-arch your lower back or lock your elbows.
Lower the weight under control and stop at shoulder height.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Machine Shoulder Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Omuz Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Neck Extension Isometric
description: A gentle isometric hold in which the head presses backward into the hands to work the back of the neck.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place both hands behind your head.
Press very lightly against your hands without moving your head backward; do not hold your breath.
Release after a short time; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the neck extension isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Boyun Ekstansiyon İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Neck Flexion Isometric
description: A gentle isometric hold in which the forehead presses forward into the palm to work the front of the neck.
instructions: Sit upright, keep your head neutral and lightly place your palm on your forehead.
Press very lightly against your hand without moving your head forward; breathe comfortably.
Release after a short time; stop immediately if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the neck flexion isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Boyun Fleksiyon İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Neck Rotation Isometric
description: A gentle isometric hold in which the head presses toward a turn against the hand, without moving, to work the neck rotators.
instructions: Sit upright and keep your head neutral; lightly place your palm beside your temple.
Press very lightly toward your hand without turning your head; keep breathing comfortably.
Release after a short time and try the other side; stop if you feel pain, numbness or dizziness.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the neck rotation isometric, neck muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Boyun Rotasyon İzometriği yapan gri tonlu sporcu; boyun kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
description: A vertical pull-up performed on parallel handles with the palms facing each other.
instructions: Grip the parallel-handle bar with your palms facing each other; hang without swinging.
Pull your elbows down and toward your body, bringing your chin up to handle level.
Extend your arms under control and return to the start; do not squeeze your shoulders toward your ears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Neutral-Grip Pull-Up, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Nötr Tutuşlu Barfiks hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Nordic Hamstring Curl
description: A bodyweight knee-flexion exercise in which the torso is lowered forward from the knees against anchored ankles.
instructions: Kneel and anchor the ankles under a secure support; keep the body in a straight line from the knees to the head.
Lean slowly forward without bending at the hips; catch yourself with the hands near the floor when needed.
Work only within the range you can control and use the hands for support to return to the start; do not force it and fall.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Nordic Hamstring Curl, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Nordic Hamstring Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
description: A unilateral dumbbell row with the opposite hand supported on a bench.
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench; keep the back flat and hold the dumbbell in the working hand.
Pull the elbow toward the hip to bring the dumbbell beside the torso; do not rotate the torso.
Lower the dumbbell under control beneath the shoulder; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the One-Arm Dumbbell Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Kol Dambıl Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: A cable triceps extension performed with the rope held behind the head and the arms extended overhead.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and turn your back to the pulley; hold the rope behind your head.
Fix your elbows beside your head and extend your arms upward under control.
Slowly bend your elbows to return to the start; do not over-arch your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Overhead Cable Triceps Extension, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kabloyla Baş Üstü Arka Kol Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Standing Overhead Press
description: A standing barbell press that moves the weight from shoulder height to overhead.
instructions: Hold a bar at shoulder height and brace the torso.
Press overhead, then lower to the starting position.

name: Forearm Plank
description: A static forearm support that challenges trunk position and bracing.
instructions: Place forearms and toes on the floor with elbows below shoulders.
Brace the torso and hold a straight body line while breathing.

name: Plate Front Raise
description: A front raise performed with a weight plate held in both hands to train the front deltoids.
instructions: Hold a light weight plate in both hands in front of your thighs; keep your knees soft.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent, raise the plate forward to shoulder height.
Lower the plate slowly without swinging your torso; stop the movement if shoulder pain appears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Plate Front Raise, front deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Plakayla Öne Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Plate Pinch
description: A static grip hold in which two weight plates are pinched together between the fingers and thumb to train grip and forearm strength.
instructions: Pinch two weight plates together with your fingertips, smooth sides facing outward.
Keeping your shoulders relaxed, continue gripping the plates beside you for a controlled period of time.
Lower the plates safely without dropping them on your feet; if you are about to lose your grip, put them down on the floor.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Plate Pinch, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Plaka Pinch Tutuşu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Pogo Hops
description: A low-amplitude plyometric drill of small, rhythmic hops driven from the ankles.
instructions: Stand tall with the feet hip-width apart and the knees slightly softened.
Make small, rhythmic hops from the ankles, touching the floor lightly with the forefoot.
Continue with soft landings without bending the knees deeply; stop if you feel discomfort.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Pogo Hops, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Pogo Sıçramaları hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Preacher Curl
description: An EZ-bar curl performed with the upper arms resting on a preacher pad, which limits swinging and isolates the biceps.
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench and place your upper arms on the pad; grip the EZ bar with your palms facing up.
Without lifting your elbows from the pad, curl the bar toward your shoulders under control.
Lower the bar slowly; do not lock your elbows hard and do not swing the load.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Preacher Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Scott Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Prone Cobra Hold
description: A prone isometric hold in which the chest and hands are lifted slightly off the floor.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms beside your body and rest your forehead comfortably on the floor.
Keeping your neck neutral, lift your chest and hands slightly; gently draw your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold briefly and lower under control; if you feel discomfort in your lower back, reduce the lift height or stop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Prone Cobra Hold, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüzüstü Kobra Tutuşu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Prone Incline Y Raise
description: A light dumbbell raise performed face down on an incline bench with the arms moving into a Y shape.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells; extend your arms in a Y shape in front of your head.
With your thumbs pointing up, raise your arms under control; keep your neck and torso still.
Lower the dumbbells slowly; if you feel pinching in your shoulders, reduce the weight or stop the movement.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Prone Incline Y Raise, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Eğimli Sehpada Yüzüstü Y Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Prone Trap-3 Raise
description: A light dumbbell raise performed face down on an incline bench with the arms moving along a Y line.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with light dumbbells; let your arms hang in a Y shape in front of your head.
With your thumbs pointing up, raise your arms under control along the Y line; keep your neck neutral.
Lower the dumbbells slowly; if you feel pinching in your shoulders, reduce the load or stop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Prone Trap-3 Raise, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yüzüstü Trap-3 Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Pull-Up
description: A vertical bodyweight pull using an overhand grip on a secure bar.
instructions: Hang from a secure bar with an overhand grip.
Pull the chest toward the bar, then lower under control.

name: Push-Up
description: A bodyweight horizontal press performed in a plank position.
instructions: Set hands under or slightly wider than the shoulders in a plank.
Lower the chest with a straight torso, then press back up.

name: Quadruped Fire Hydrant
description: A quadruped exercise in which a bent knee is lifted out to the side to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Get on your hands and knees; place your hands under your shoulders and your knees under your hips.
Keeping your knee bent, lift one leg out to the side; keep your pelvis parallel to the floor and your torso still.
Slowly lower the knee and switch sides; work in a pain-free range without rotating your lower back sideways.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the quadruped fire hydrant, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dört Ayak Üzerinde Fire Hydrant yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.
