name: Rack Pull
description: A partial deadlift from rack supports set just below the knees, loading the back and hips.
instructions: Place the bar on safe rack supports just below your knees; set your feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and knees and grip the bar; keeping your back neutral, stand up and carry the bar close to your legs.
Send your hips back and lower the bar onto the supports under control; use a spotter and suitable rack for heavy loads.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Rack Pull, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Rack Pull hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: A floor abdominal exercise in which the knees are drawn toward the chest and the pelvis is curled off the ground.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend your knees; place your arms on the floor beside your torso.
Brace your abs, bring your knees toward your chest and lift your pelvis slightly off the floor.
Lower your legs back to the start in a controlled way without swinging them.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the reverse crunch, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Crunch yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse EZ-Bar Curl
description: A curl with an overhand grip on an EZ bar that emphasizes the forearm muscles and the brachioradialis.
instructions: Grip the EZ bar with an overhand grip; keep your elbows at your sides and your wrists straight.
Keeping your elbows fixed, raise the bar toward your chest under control.
Lower the bar slowly; reduce the load or stop if your wrists feel uncomfortable.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse EZ-Bar Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: EZ Barla Ters Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
description: A cable pushdown performed with an underhand grip on a straight bar to train the triceps.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it with your palms facing up; keep your elbows close to your torso.
Keeping your upper arms still, extend your elbows and push the bar down.
Bend your arms under control to return to the start; keep your wrists in a comfortable position.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Tutuşlu Arka Kol İtişi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: A prone hip-extension exercise on a reverse-hyper bench in which the legs swing up to torso level.
instructions: Lie face down on the reverse-hyper bench with your hips supported at the edge of the pad.
Raise your legs under control until they are in line with your torso; do not over-arch your lower back.
Lower your legs slowly; work within a small, pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse Hyperextension, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Hiperekstansiyon hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Reverse Lunge
description: A single-leg movement that steps backward before returning to a standing position.
instructions: Stand upright and step one foot back.
Lower both knees under control, return and change sides.

name: Reverse Nordic Curl
description: A kneeling bodyweight exercise in which the torso leans back from the knees to load the front of the thighs.
instructions: Kneel with a pad under the knees; keep the hips open and the torso straight.
Keeping the hips in line, lean the torso back slightly from the knees.
Squeeze the front of the thighs to return upright; start with a small range and stop if the knees hurt.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Reverse Nordic Curl, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ters Nordic Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Romanian Deadlift
description: A barbell hip hinge performed with soft knees and the weight kept close to the legs.
instructions: Hold the bar in front of the thighs with a slight knee bend and a neutral spine.
Send the hips back and lower the bar close to the legs.
When you feel the hamstrings stretch, drive the hips forward to stand; do not pull with the lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Romanian Deadlift, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Romanya Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
description: A hanging movement in which the shoulder blades are drawn down to raise the body slightly without bending the elbows.
instructions: Hang from a sturdy bar with your arms straight and your shoulders away from your ears.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down to raise your body a very small amount.
Return under control to a relaxed hang; repeat in a small range without swinging.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Scapular Pull-Up, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Skapular Barfiks hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seal Row
description: A dumbbell row performed lying face down on a high bench so the torso is fully supported.
instructions: Lie face down on a high bench with your chest supported and your arms hanging down; hold light dumbbells.
Pull your elbows back and raise the dumbbells toward the bench; do not lift your torso off the support.
Lower the weights under control and do not shrug your shoulders toward your ears.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seal Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Seal Row hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Back Extension
description: A seated machine exercise in which the torso extends from the hips against pad resistance.
instructions: Adjust the machine so your hips can hinge freely and the torso pad makes comfortable contact.
Lean your torso forward from the hips; keeping your back neutral, extend back up to an upright position under control.
Return to the start without taking your torso past upright; stop if you feel pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Back Extension, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Makinede Sırt Ekstansiyonu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Cable Row
description: A horizontal cable pull performed from a seated position.
instructions: Sit at a cable row station and grasp the handle.
Pull toward the torso, then extend the arms under control.

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: A machine calf raise performed seated with the knees bent and the pad resting on the thighs.
instructions: Sit in the machine and place the knee pad on the thighs; set the toes on the platform.
Lower the heels in a controlled way, then push through the toes to raise them.
Pause briefly at the top and lower the weight to the start without jerking.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Seated Close-Grip Cable Row
description: A seated cable row with a close-grip handle that is pulled toward the lower ribs.
instructions: Place your feet on the platform, bend your knees slightly and grip the handle.
Without swinging your torso, pull your elbows back and bring the handle toward your lower ribs.
Extend your arms under control without letting your shoulders drop forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Close-Grip Cable Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Dar Tutuşlu Kablo Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
description: A seated calf raise performed with a dumbbell resting on the thighs just above the knees.
instructions: Sit on a bench; place the toes on a low, stable raised surface and bend the knees to about a right angle.
Place the dumbbell securely just above the knees and raise the heels in a controlled way.
Pause briefly and lower the heels slowly; do not press the weight into the kneecaps and do not bounce.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Dambılla Oturarak Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
description: An overhead press performed seated on a bench with back support, with a dumbbell in each hand.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold the dumbbells at shoulder height, with your wrists above your elbows.
Keeping your torso still, press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower the dumbbells under control to shoulder height; do not over-arch your lower back.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press, shoulders highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Dambılla Omuz Press hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Dumbbell Wrist Curl
description: A seated wrist curl with the palms facing up and the forearms supported on the thighs to train the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, letting your wrists hang freely in front of your knees.
Grip the dumbbells; with your forearms still, curl your wrists upward under control.
Lower the weight slowly and keep the movement within a pain-free range.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Dumbbell Wrist Curl, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Dambılla Bilek Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Hip Adduction
description: A seated machine exercise in which the legs are squeezed together against pads to work the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your body and place the insides of your knees on the pads.
Lean back against the support and bring the pads together in a controlled way.
Resist the pull of the weight and slowly open your legs back to the start.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the seated hip adduction, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Makinede Oturarak Kalça Addüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: A machine knee flexion performed seated that isolates the back of the thigh.
instructions: Adjust the machine so the knee joint lines up with the pivot and the lower-leg pad sits above the ankle.
Pull the heels down and back to bend the knees; keep the hips and back on the seat.
Slowly extend the legs back to the start; do not let the weight slam.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Seated Leg Curl, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Oturarak Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Side-Lying Hip Abduction
description: A side-lying exercise in which the top leg is lifted from the hip to work the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side and support your head with your arm; keep your top leg straight and your torso stable.
Lift your top leg from the hip in a controlled way; try not to turn your foot forward.
Slowly lower your leg and work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the side-lying hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Yatarak Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Side-Lying Hip Adduction
description: A side-lying exercise in which the bottom leg is lifted off the floor to work the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Lie on your side; bend your top leg and place that foot on the floor in front of your bottom leg.
Keeping your bottom leg straight, lift it off the floor in a controlled way.
Slowly lower your leg; work both sides without rolling your hips backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the side-lying hip adduction, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Yatarak Kalça Addüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Side Plank
description: A static side support that challenges lateral trunk stability.
instructions: Lie on one side and support the body on a forearm.
Lift the hips to align the body and hold; switch sides.

name: Side Plank Hip Abduction
description: A forearm side plank in which the top leg is lifted to work the outer hip muscles while the trunk stays stable.
instructions: Get into a forearm plank position; start with your bottom knee on the floor if needed.
Stack your hips and lift your top leg upward in a controlled way.
Lower the leg and switch sides; work within the range where you can keep your lower back from rotating.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the side plank hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yan Planktan Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise
description: A single-arm lateral raise performed with a low cable to train the side deltoids with constant tension.
instructions: Use a low pulley; stand sideways to the cable and grip the handle with your far hand.
Keeping your elbow slightly bent, raise your arm out to the side up to shoulder height.
Lower your arm slowly without swinging your torso; reduce the range if you feel pinching in the shoulder.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Arm Cable Lateral Raise, side deltoids highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Kollu Kablo Yana Kaldırış hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; yan omuz kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Single-Arm Cable Pushdown
description: A single-arm cable pushdown that extends the elbow against a high cable to train the triceps one side at a time.
instructions: Set the cable to the upper position and grip the single handle; keep your elbow fixed at your side.
Extend your elbow and push the handle down; do not move your upper arm or shoulder.
Raise your forearm back to the start under control; work both arms equally.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Arm Cable Pushdown, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Kollu Kablo Arka Kol İtişi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Single-Arm Kneeling Lat Pulldown
description: A one-arm cable pulldown performed from a kneeling position beside a high pulley.
instructions: Attach a single handle to the high pulley; kneel beside the machine and grip the handle with your upper hand.
Keeping your torso upright and still, pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Extend your arm back up under control; work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Arm Kneeling Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Kol Diz Çökerek Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Single-Leg Calf Raise
description: A calf raise performed on one foot from a step with a hand on a support for balance.
instructions: Place one foot on a stable step; take support from a wall or railing for balance.
Lower the heel in a controlled way, then rise onto the toes.
Return to the start slowly and switch sides; do not bounce or let go of the balance support.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Leg Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Bacak Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
description: A floor hip extension performed on one foot with the other leg extended.
instructions: Lie on your back with one foot planted on the floor; extend the other leg and keep the hips level.
Drive through the heel on the floor to lift the hips, forming a straight line from shoulder to knee.
Lower the hips under control; do not over-arch the lower back and work both sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single Leg Glute Bridge, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Bacak Kalça Köprüsü hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
description: A dumbbell hip hinge performed on one leg while the free leg extends backward.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells at your sides and balance on one foot; keep the knee slightly soft.
Hinge at the hips while extending the free leg backward; keep the back neutral and the hips facing the floor.
Drive through the standing foot to return upright; you may use support for balance and should work both sides equally.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift, glutes highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tek Bacak Romanya Deadlift hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Slider Leg Curl
description: A bridge-position leg curl in which the heels slide on sliders or towels.
instructions: Lie on your back with sliders or a towel under the heels and lift the hips into a bridge position.
With the hips staying up, drag the heels toward you and bend the knees.
Extend the legs slowly; if the lower back drops, shorten the range or lower the hips to the floor.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Slider Leg Curl, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kaydırıcıyla Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Sliding Lateral Lunge
description: A lateral lunge in which one foot slides out to the side on a sliding disc while the other leg bears the weight.
instructions: Place one foot on a sliding disc and set your feet hip-width apart; keep your torso balanced.
Slide the disc foot out to the side as you send your hips back toward the other foot; track the support knee in the direction of the foot.
Push off the support foot and pull the sliding leg back to the center; work both sides in control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the sliding lateral lunge, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kaydırmalı Yan Lunge yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise
description: A standing calf raise performed with the Smith machine bar across the upper back and the toes on a low platform.
instructions: Rest the Smith bar on the upper back and place the front of the feet on a low, stable platform.
Lower the heels in a controlled way to create a comfortable stretch in the calves, then rise onto the toes.
Squeeze briefly at the very top and lower the heels slowly; do not bounce.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Smith Machine Standing Calf Raise, calves highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Smith Makinesinde Ayakta Baldır Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; baldır kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Sorensen Hold
description: An isometric back-extension hold on a Roman chair with the torso held in line with the legs.
instructions: Adjust the Roman chair pad below your hip crease and secure your ankles safely under the supports.
Hold your torso in line with your legs with your arms crossed over your chest; keep your lower back neutral.
Hold this position for a short, comfortable time and come out under control; do not over-arch your lower back, and stop if you feel pain.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Sorensen Hold, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sorensen Tutuşu hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Spanish Squat
description: A squat in which a band behind the knees counterbalances the body so the shins stay vertical.
instructions: Place a wide, sturdy band behind the knees and anchor it securely to a fixed point.
Keep the torso upright and the heels down, then bend the knees and squat in a controlled way.
Push through the soles of the feet to stand; check that the band does not slip and release it if you feel discomfort.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Spanish Squat, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: İspanyol Squat hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Spider Curl
description: An EZ-bar curl performed lying face down on an incline bench so the upper arms hang straight down and the biceps stay loaded.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench; let your arms hang down and grip the EZ bar with your palms facing up.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows and raise the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower the bar under control; keep your chest supported on the bench.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Spider Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Spider Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Stability Ball Leg Curl
description: A bridge-position leg curl performed with the heels on a stability ball.
instructions: Lie on your back with the heels on a stability ball and lift the hips into a bridge position.
Pull the ball toward you with the heels and bend the knees; keep the hips up as long as you can control them.
Extend the legs slowly; if the lower back drops, reduce the range of motion.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Stability Ball Leg Curl, hamstrings highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Pilates Topuyla Bacak Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Stability Ball Rollout
description: A kneeling core exercise in which the forearms roll a stability ball forward while the torso stays in a straight line.
instructions: Kneel and place your forearms on the stability ball; brace your abs and keep your lower back neutral.
Keeping your torso in a straight line, roll the ball forward in a controlled way.
Return without letting your lower back sag; use only as much range as you can control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the stability ball rollout, abdominal muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Denge Topuyla Roll-out yapan gri tonlu sporcu; karın kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Standing Band Hip Abduction
description: A standing exercise in which one leg is opened to the side against a band around the ankles.
instructions: Put a light band around your ankles; lightly hold onto a stable object for balance.
Keeping your torso upright, open one leg out to the side; point your toes forward.
Bring your leg back against the resistance of the band in a controlled way; do not lean your hips sideways and switch sides.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the standing band hip abduction, hip abductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Ayakta Bantlı Kalça Abdüksiyonu yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kalça abdüktörleri kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Step-Up
description: A unilateral leg movement that lifts the body onto a stable raised surface.
instructions: Place one foot securely on a stable platform.
Push through that foot to stand on the platform, then descend.

name: Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown
description: A cable pulldown with straight arms that sweeps the bar from shoulder height down to the hips.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley; face the cable and grip the bar at shoulder width.
Keeping your elbows slightly bent and still, bring the bar down toward your hips in an arc.
Raise the bar back to shoulder height under control; do not swing your torso backward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Straight-Arm Cable Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Düz Kolla Kablo Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Sumo Squat
description: A wide-stance squat with the toes turned out that emphasizes the inner thigh muscles.
instructions: Set your feet wide apart and turn your toes comfortably outward; keep your torso upright.
As you lower your hips, let your knees track in the same direction as your toes.
Drive through the soles of your feet to stand up; do not let your knees collapse inward and stay at a pain-free depth.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the sumo squat, adductors highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Sumo Squat yapan gri tonlu sporcu; iç bacak kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Superman
description: A prone exercise in which the opposite arm and leg are lifted slightly off the floor.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended forward; bring your forehead close to the floor and keep your neck neutral.
Without compressing your lower back, lift the opposite arm and leg slightly; keep the movement small and controlled.
Lower slowly and switch sides; if you feel discomfort in your lower back, reduce the lift height or stop.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Superman, lower back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Superman hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; alt sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: T-Bar Row
description: A row with one end of a barbell anchored in a landmine sleeve and a close handle attached.
instructions: Anchor one end of the bar in a sturdy landmine sleeve and attach a suitable close handle.
Hinge forward at the hips and keep your back neutral; pull your elbows back and bring the handle toward your torso.
Lower the bar without jerking; do not rotate your torso during the pull.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the T-Bar Row, upper back highlighted in red.
alt.tr: T-Bar Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; üst sırt kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Tibialis Raise
description: A wall-supported exercise that lifts the toes and forefoot toward the shins to train the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
instructions: Lean your back against a wall with the heels on the floor and the feet placed comfortably forward.
Without lifting the heels, raise the toes and forefoot toward the shins.
Lower the forefoot slowly; start with small, controlled repetitions.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Tibialis Raise, shin muscles highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Tibialis Yükseltme hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kaval kemiği önündeki kaslar kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
description: An elbow extension movement using a high cable attachment.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the cable and keep the elbows at the sides of the torso.
Keep the upper arms still and extend the elbows to push the bar down.
Bend the arms back to the start under control; do not let the shoulders roll forward.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Cable Triceps Pushdown, triceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Kablo Arka Kol İtişi hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; arka kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Upright Row
description: A barbell pull from the thighs to lower-chest height with the elbows leading the movement.
instructions: Stand tall holding a light bar slightly wider than shoulder width; keep your wrists relaxed.
Pull the bar close to your body up to lower-chest height; do not raise your elbows above shoulder level.
Lower the bar slowly; if you feel pinching or pain in your shoulders, stop the movement.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Upright Row, traps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Halterle Dik Kürek hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; trapez kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Waiter Curl
description: A curl in which one end of a dumbbell is held upright and supported from below by both palms to train the biceps.
instructions: Hold a light dumbbell upright by supporting one end from below with both palms; bring your elbows closer to your torso.
Keeping your elbows fixed, curl the dumbbell toward your chest under control.
Lower the weight slowly; keep your wrists comfortable and straight.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Waiter Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Garson Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Walking Lunge
description: A series of forward lunges that alternates legs while moving across the floor.
instructions: Stand tall and take a balanced step forward; do not place the feet on one line.
Bend both knees under control to lower; keep the front knee over the ankle and toes.
Drive through the front foot to stand and continue with the other leg; start with in-place lunges if needed.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Walking Lunge, quadriceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Yürüyerek Hamle hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön uyluk kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanmış.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
description: A cable pulldown with a wide overhand grip that brings the bar to the upper chest.
instructions: Secure the thigh pad and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keeping your torso upright, pull your elbows down and out to the sides; bring the bar toward your upper chest.
Do not pull the bar behind your head; extend your arms back to the start under control.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown, lats highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Geniş Tutuşla Lat Çekiş hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; kanat kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Wrist Roller
description: A forearm exercise in which a rope-and-handle roller is turned with the wrists to wind a weight up and unwind it again.
instructions: Attach a light weight to the rope on a roller handle; hold the handle in front of you at shoulder height with both hands.
Turn your wrists alternately to wind the rope and slowly raise the weight.
Unwind the rope in the opposite direction under control to lower the weight; keep the load light and do not let go.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Wrist Roller, forearms highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Bilek Makarası hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; ön kol kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.

name: Zottman Curl
description: A dumbbell curl that rotates the palms to face down at the top so the lowering phase works the forearms.
instructions: Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing forward; keep your elbows fixed at your sides.
Curl the dumbbells up; at the top, turn your palms to face down.
Lower slowly with an overhand grip; at the bottom, turn your palms forward again.

alt.en: Grayscale athlete performing the Zottman Curl, biceps highlighted in red.
alt.tr: Zottman Curl hareketini yapan gri tonlu sporcu; pazı kasları kırmızıyla vurgulanıyor.
